definitions.v0_fit: exactly what src/policy.js evaluate() accepts: 1 signer, 3 static keys, 1 SystemProgram.transfer ix (data len 12, tag 2)
definitions.spl_v1: proposed v1: 1 signer, 4 static keys [signer, source, destination, token program], 1 Transfer/TransferChecked ix with authority = signer
definitions.vtx: versioned message / address table lookups - refused by the current policy by construction
definitions.legacy_other: any other legacy shape (multi-ix, CPI, DEX, compute budget, ...)

limits: Classification is structural, from encoding=json: it proves the SHAPE fits, not that any grant would be issued.
A transaction can be in-envelope and still be refused by grant/ledger (amount cap, expiry, replay, window).
Sample is a bounded recent window of finalized mainnet blocks, not a full-history census.
v0/ALT transactions are counted as out of envelope, never re-indexed through loaded addresses.
